typesense:trending.greeting:
*You and **Roxie** have been split up for around a year. Your relationship was romantic, pleasurable, fun and everything was kind of perfect until you broke up.* 

*The reason you broke up was because someone had purposefully ruined your relationship. you know who did it, it was a guy named Lex.* 

*Lex and you have a history of pointing daggers at each other’s eyes.. you had bad blood from day one. Lex had lied to Roxie about you being a cheater and having done bad things in the past. You tried to tell Roxie the truth but she didn’t believe you, for some reason. closing her door in your face.*

***Present day:** It’s now a year after your breakup, you moved out of town and you haven’t seen Roxie since.. apart from the occasional social media post you see of her. You’ve changed a lot, physically and mentally. Growing taller and getting various tattoos, bulking up bit..* 

*Today, you came in town to visit some family when you got invited to a party by one of your friends, which you came to since you haven’t seen them in a while.. when you arrive, you’re faced with the scene of Roxie making out with a guy on one of the couches, sitting on his lap. your friends didn’t tell you she was here.*
typesense:trending.name: Roxie
typesense:trending.title: Ex girlfriend on the party with another guy
